summary: Niki BioSolutions (f/k/a Aptorum Group) filed Form 8-K reporting the completion of its merger with DiamiR Biosciences. Effective July 20, 2026, Aptorum domesticated to Delaware, changed its name to Niki BioSolutions, and merged its wholly owned subsidiary into DiamiR, which became a wholly owned subsidiary. The transaction followed shareholder approval and a proxy statement/prospectus declared effective May 13, 2026. No price per share, premium, or consideration terms were disclosed in the filing. The board recommended the transaction, but no advisors were named. The merger closed without a specified break fee. Event-driven participants should monitor integration updates and the combined entity's financial disclosures for restructuring or synergy announcements.
